# nomatron_oidc_provider (Resource)

Nomatron OIDC provider resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "nomatron_oidc_provider" "google" {
  slug             = "google"
  display_name     = "Google Workspace"
  issuer_url       = "https://accounts.google.com"
  client_id        = "google-client-id.apps.googleusercontent.com"
  client_secret_wo = var.google_oidc_client_secret

  scopes         = ["openid", "profile", "email"]
  username_claim = "email"
  email_claim    = "email"
  name_claim     = "name"
  groups_claim   = "groups"

  allowed_email_domains = ["example.com"]
  enabled               = true
  is_default            = true
  auto_provision        = true
  sync_profile          = true
  sync_groups           = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `client_id` (String) OIDC client ID.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable provider name.
- `issuer_url` (String) OIDC issuer URL.
- `slug` (String) Stable OIDC provider slug.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `allowed_email_domains` (List of String) Optional allow-list of email domains permitted to authenticate through this provider.
- `auto_provision` (Boolean) Whether valid first-time OIDC logins auto-create Nomatron users.
- `client_secret_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) OIDC client secret. This value is write-only and is never stored in Terraform state.
- `email_claim` (String) Claim used for the user's email address.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether this provider can be used for login.
- `groups_claim` (String) Claim containing external group values.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this provider is the default OIDC login provider.
- `name_claim` (String) Claim used for the display name.
- `scopes` (List of String) OIDC scopes requested during login.
- `sync_groups` (Boolean) Whether external group claims synchronize mapped RBAC assignments at login.
- `sync_profile` (Boolean) Whether profile fields are synchronized at login.
- `username_claim` (String) Claim used for the Nomatron username.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) OIDC provider ID.
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the provider was last updated.
